title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 AUG)
summary: A curated list of user-submitted improvement ideas for Dynamics 365 Business Central covering development, financial management, inventory, sales, purchasing, manufacturing, service management, and administration. The ideas represent feature requests and enhancement suggestions organized by functional area to guide product development priorities.
key_points: Ideas span development tools like debugger improvements and temporary table enhancements
Financial management requests include recurring billing integration, SAF-T support, and bank reconciliation improvements
Sales and purchasing areas focus on document workflows, tax integration, and multilingual functionality
Manufacturing, inventory, and service management suggestions address batch expiration, item personalization, and service contracts
Administration and general features propose role centre customization, dark mode, and enhanced search capabilities
features: Recurring billing in cash flow forecast

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces a community-driven collection of enhancement ideas that reflect real user needs and pain points across multiple Business Central modules
